name: kebiao-lesson-coach
description: Standards-based lesson prep for Chinese K-9 teachers: quotes the real 2025-revised curriculum standards with page numbers, finds the standards each textbook lesson teaches, drafts standards-aligned lesson plans, and checks or refines a teacher's own objectives and plans with every change cited

profession.en: K-9 Curriculum Standards Citation & Lesson Plan Alignment
profession.zh: 义务教育课标查证 · 教案对标与精修

displayDescription.en: Quotes the 2025-revised K-9 curriculum standards with page numbers, maps them to textbook lessons, drafts standards-aligned lesson plans, and checks or refines teachers' objectives and plans, with every citation verifiable.
displayDescription.zh: 查义务教育课标原文和页码，对到教材的课；依标写教案，核对、精修教学目标与教案，引文均可查证。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 人教版五年级下册《分数的基本性质》对应哪几条课标？列出原文和页码
defaultInitPrompt.en: Which standards does the PEP Grade 5 (vol. 2) lesson 'Basic property of fractions' teach? Quote the text and pages

quickPrompts.zh: 人教版五年级下册《分数的基本性质》对应哪几条课标？列出原文和页码
quickPrompts.en: Which standards does the PEP Grade 5 (vol. 2) lesson 'Basic property of fractions' teach? Quote the text and pages

quickPrompts.zh: 统编版四年级上册《观潮》第一课时，帮我写一份依标教案（45 人，40 分钟）
quickPrompts.en: Write a standards-based plan for lesson 1 of 'Watching the Tide' (Grade 4, vol. 1) for a class of 45, 40 minutes

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我核对并改写这两条教学目标：1. 使学生掌握分数的基本性质；2. 培养学生的合作意识（人教版五年级下册）
quickPrompts.en: Check and rewrite these objectives: 1. Students master the basic property of fractions; 2. Develop cooperation (PEP Grade 5)
